verdict.rationale: Accessing files from other apps' sandboxes is a fair question for a cross-platform SSH/SFTP client with mobile apps, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows SFTP management of local or remote files on desktop and terminal-to-SFTP switching. Nothing documents access to other apps' sandboxed files or repositories (for example, iOS Files or document-provider integration), so this is adjacent capability only.

support.subject: As a developer, I can access and work with files and repositories from other apps' sandboxes on my device
